exposure: Women who underwent a trial of vaginal delivery following successful ECV
finding: Polyhydramnios, transverse lie, and posterior placenta were associated with successful ECV, while nulliparity was associated with lower success; women with successful ECV had higher OVD rates but similar CS rates compared to spontaneous vertex presentation.
mod_finding: Women who had a successful ECV and underwent a trial of labor were more likely to deliver by operative vaginal delivery (OVD).
